title: Rank the shapes
hints: `slices.SortFunc` works on a `[]Shape` like on any slice; the comparison function receives two `Shape`s and can only call `Area()` and `Name()`. Sort a `slices.Clone` so the caller's slice stays untouched.

Compare with `cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(a.Area(), b.Area()), cmp.Compare(a.Name(), b.Name()))`. For `TopN`, swap the area arguments (`cmp.Compare(b.Area(), a.Area())`) and return `out[:min(n, len(out))]` after handling `n <= 0`. Use `slices.SortStableFunc` so full ties keep their input order.
`Kind` is `switch s.(type) { case nil: return "none"; case Square, Rect: return "polygon"; case Circle: return "round"; default: return "unknown" }`.
